thread:
andrea: Heads-up — postsubmit auto-promote for release window failed. Integration job 'session-dump-seed' flakes intermittently, blocking the cut.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: postsubmit checks failed (integration-tests). See CI: https://ci.redwood/example/1223 :warning:

sam: Logs look like a nondeterministic failure tied to test seed. Failing seeds vary across runs. Repro locally with `SEED=847` once, `SEED=1932` next.

prateek: This started after the concurrency change in the test runner last night (reduced fixture isolation). I can see ordering-dependent teardown in that test.

andrea: Options: 1) manual-promote last-known-good image for demo, 2) rebuild with old runner-concurrency=1 to see if flake disappears, 3) hotfix the test harness. Need consensus — change window is now.

carmen: We prefer not to skip integrations unless unavoidable. How long to get a safe rebuild? We have a demo in 90m.

sam: Rebuild ETA ~20m if I kick now; but no guarantee flaky test won't show up again. Manual promote is fastest.

prateek: Manual promote is acceptable if we annotate release notes and create a rollback plan. We should also run a quick smoke harness post-promote.

andrea: Deploy command for manual promote: ``deploybot promote --image=sha256:2f4b1c --reason="temp-unblock-release-window"`` — that will bypass auto-promote checks but still run smoke. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

carmen: If we manual-promote, require: 1) postmortem created, 2) a toggle to revert to automatic promotion within 2 hours if regression appears, 3) inform oncall. Otherwise delay.

sam: I'll start the rebuild in parallel. If rebuild passes full postsubmit, we can replace promoted image with rebuilt one.

andrea: OK I'm going to manual-promote last-green for the demo, will include metadata and follow-up ticket. Kicking it in 2m. @deploy-bot run smoke after promote.

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated by andrea. Running smoke tests and routing traffic to staged slot.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed (10/10). Promotion complete. Traffic routed. :rocket:

andrea: I created a tracking issue CHOWN-55: "unstable session-dump-seed test after concurrency change" and assigned to prateek/sam. Will attach logs and seed replay info.

carmen: Approved manual promote for demo. Please do a short postmortem and schedule the full fix for tomorrow.

prateek: I'll start triage immediately and try the reduced-concurrency rebuild Sam kicked.

andrea: Closing this thread — release window unblocked. Follow-up updates and postmortem will be in #release-notes and CHOWN-55. Thanks all.
